## Create SpatialData objects

This code is inspired by [this tutorial](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/latest/tutorials/notebooks/notebooks/examples/alignment_using_landmarks.html)

```{python}
import numpy as np
import spatialdata as sd

from napari_spatialdata import Interactive
import spatialdata_io as sio
import spatialdata_plot

sham = sio.visium(path="data/Sample_S54407_Sham1_3_5/outs/", dataset_id="Sham")
sham

sham.pl.render_images().pl.render_shapes().pl.show("downscaled_hires")
sham.pl.render_images().pl.render_shapes().pl.show("global")
```

## Visualize with Napari

```{python}
Interactive(sham)
```
